nameLesson.label: Name your lesson
nameLesson.body: Start at the top of the page and type a title for your lesson, for example "The Life of Albert Einstein". You can change it any time.

addSection.label: Add a section
addSection.body: Press the round + button (bottom-right) or Add section to create your first section, such as a word list or a practice exercise. Lessons are built from one or more sections.

fillContent.label: Fill in content
fillContent.body: Inside a section, add content blocks: spelling words, instructions, images, and questions. Reorder or remove blocks until the section reads the way you want.

previewShare.label: Preview & share
previewShare.body: When you're happy, use Preview to see the printable result, Export to download a Word doc or PDF, or Publish to hub to share it with others.
